katana.note: Katana root in the RightHand joint (like weapons/attach.json)

scabbard.note: Scabbard root in this joint; diagonally across the back

seat.note: sheathed: make Katana a child of the KatanaSeat empty with an identity transform (this is the seat's own pose inside Scabbard, for reference)

axes: glTF: Y up, the duck faces +Z, meters, feet at y = 0; angles are degrees from forward, positive to the duck's right

checkpoints.note: the Tip empty's position in the duck's model space at these exact frames, the clip played alone (for tests)

Dash.flow: from anything with the katana out; ends in Katana_Idle

Draw.flow: from the unarmed upper body (Idle); ends in Katana_Idle's upper body

Heavy_Charge.flow: loop while the heavy button is held (enter from Katana_Idle with a 0.15 s crossfade)

Heavy_Release.flow: from Heavy_Charge on release; recovers to Katana_Idle

Katana_Idle.flow: loop; the base of every katana move

Katana_Run.flow: loop over Run_* or Sprint (upper layer); sync its time to the run's phase

syncWith.note: same length as Run_F: set its time to the run's normalized time x 0.367

Quack_Shockwave.flow: from anything with the katana out; recovers to Katana_Idle

Sheathe.flow: from Katana_Idle's upper body; ends in the unarmed Idle upper body

Slash_1.flow: from Katana_Idle or Katana_Run; recovers to Katana_Idle

Slash_2.flow: from Slash_1 inside its combo window; recovers to Katana_Idle

Slash_3.flow: from Slash_2 inside its combo window; recovers to Katana_Idle

Ultimate.flow: activation; ends in Ultimate_Spin's first pose

Ultimate_Spin.flow: loop for the blade storm's duration; leave to Katana_Idle with a 0.1 s crossfade

dash.note: fraction of the distance covered at each 30 fps frame of Dash (frame 0 to 8); no root motion in the clip

EliteRing.note: ground ring under an elite enemy; spin slowly

Feather.note: XP pickup, toon material, origin at its middle; bob and spin it

Shockwave.note: ground ring with a short wall; scale up from the impact, fade by time

SlashArc.note: flat crescent on the XZ plane centered on +Z; u=0 at the duck's right end, u=1 the bright leading left end; scale by the swing reach, mirror x for left-to-right, tilt for diagonals

fx.material: MeleeFx: vertex colors (COLOR_0) hold the glow ramp; draw additive, depthWrite off, double sided

katana.axes: katana space: blade along +Y, cutting edge toward -Z, flats along X

nodes.Katana: mesh, origin at the grip (the right fist's center)
nodes.TrailEnd: empty on the edge near the tip
nodes.TrailStart: empty on the edge near the guard
